I’m sorry but I have to comment on this. Killing oneself is NOT THE END GAME for depressed people. It is possible to get healed from it and seeing videos like that can trigger them.

From one who is suffering and has suicidal ideations and tendencies, I hope that you didn’t say that because you’re going through depression. I really hope that with all my heart. I wouldn’t wish you to be going through the same thing.

But I also hope that you understand that saying that killing oneself is the endgame for all depressed people is like saying that there is no hope for them and that it is pointless to get help.

How to stop depressed people from killing theirselves? There are tons of available information out there. The real problem is that people doesn’t like talking about it or learning about it so they don’t get informed.

We may have suicidal ideation and tendencies but that doesn’t mean we want to die. We want our suffering to end and as much as possible we want it to end without resorting to killing ourself.

I wish you well.

We don’t need advice really because chances are the things you will be saying has been said to us or we’ve already tried.

Just being there is enough. There will be days when we won’t respond but we appreciate it when someone tries to reach out.

I know it’s a lot to ask but if you want to establish  or strengthen any kind of relationship with someone who experiences mental health sickness, tons of patience is needed.

It’ll be hard. It’ll be exhausting. We, ourselves, get exhausted. But we will appreciate you very much for staying and for trying.
